cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.

mechanism: A treats an employee final departure as the last jointly performed task of its training, correcting a passive agreement into participation in the farewell bell.
confusable: Not simply forcing another shift or demanding acknowledgment: the named mutual ritual ends B duty once performed.
comparison: Time-sensitive club response versus resigning pupil final joint service bell.
